dreadmarch_class_mapping.identity_rule: Guard, stance and weapon mastery; reliable physical fundamentals without a mandatory rage state.
Precision, movement and fieldcraft; bow and agile weapon play remain viable throughout the campaign.
Innate elemental power, elemental reactions and managed overcharge; Sorceress is an alias.
Rhythmic martial sequences, spirit and deliberate finishers with readable combo windows.
Self-sufficient offensive phrases, wards and rhythm; healing never requires another player.
Rage, heavy weapon commitment and forceful disruption; distinct from Warrior's stable guard play.
Spear and bow expertise with stance or range transitions and a strong martial identity.
Preparation, stealth, traps and payoff sequences; distinct from Rogue's sustained fieldcraft.
Corpses, bones and commanded undead; minion decisions matter beyond passive damage.
Oaths, auras and righteous weapon strikes; every protective path has a solo damage loop.
Persistent animal-form play, weather and living nature with meaningful form-specific actions.
Heavy shield counters, armored advance and battlefield control; distinct from Paladin's oath emphasis.
Ranged pursuit, traps and constructed sentries; translate reference firearms into setting-appropriate weapons.
Spirits, ritual objects, poison and curses; distinct from Necromancer's corpse-and-bone command.
Studied arcane geometry, time, space and constructs; distinct from Sorcerer's innate elemental core.
Life-cost conversion, drain, reach and controlled monstrous transformation.
Water and wind martial motion, afterimages and flowing attacks; no animal-form dependency.
Invoke guardian aspects through martial actions; maintain a distinct identity from full Druid shapeshifting.
Bind demons, bargain for power and exploit curse interactions through explicit pact costs.

solo_constraints: The full campaign, every class, quest route, mastery and build-defining item is achievable by one player.
Local saves and pause; no login dependency for the campaign.
No real-time daily or weekly progression gates, mandatory party roles, raid-only build items, or trading requirements.
Class, body, voice, face and background are independent choices; no gender-locked class kits.
Support-oriented disciplines must carry a tested solo offense, defense and boss-stagger loop.
Respec and build previews explain compatibility and tradeoffs before points or materials are spent.

proposed_production_targets.status: Planning floor for a funded full production; validate with content throughput and player testing, not a delivery claim.
world_requirements: Optional generated endgame encounters with authored rule sets
proposed_production_targets.vertical_slice_gate: One complete region and dungeon, an authored boss and quest consequence, persistent creator, three deeply implemented contrasting classes; all 19 remain roster goals.

research_gaps: The catalogue is complete for explicitly pinned extracted input tables, not a verified census of every live regional ability.
Lost Ark's 704 Ark Passive records have names and levels, but their complete player-facing class/tier/prerequisite graph is not present in this source.
Skill and passive identifiers do not constitute a full behavioral specification; modifier values, animation assets, tooltip prose and implementation code are not imported.
PoE gem entries may contain legacy, item-granted, variant or unreleased data; official tree class slots also include placeholders.
Historical official class articles establish mechanics provenance; current balance values and unlock thresholds must be checked against the chosen release before implementation.
PoE1 3.30.0 is explicitly a preview and is not merged into the 3.29.1 baseline.
